title: Bacalao al Pil Pil
description: A traditional Spain dish made with salt cod, garlic. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Desalt the salt cod in the refrigerator for 24–48 hours, changing cold water 3–4 times; pat the fish thoroughly dry.
Gently poach the cod with sliced garlic in warm olive oil, not boiling oil, until it flakes; move the fish to a warm plate and reserve the gelatin-rich oil.
Off direct heat, swirl and whisk the warm cooking oil with the fish juices until it emulsifies into the distinctive pale pil-pil sauce; return the cod to coat.
